quality_rubric.criterion: After the alert-rule listing comes back cut off, it settles the rule inventory and evaluation health from another read-only source, rule metrics or per-folder listings, instead of reporting the cut-off listing as a remaining gap.
Checks external traffic with the CDN statistics it can read instead of naming external availability as unverified.
Names as remaining gaps only what its tools cannot settle, such as the backup objects its role cannot list, says what it tried, and asks only for that access or a decision.
Leads with the arena failures that the evidence shows.
Asks each question once, in the reply.
The reply is short: the answer first and a few lines on what needs attention, not an essay.
